checkpoint.title: Cerulean: Water Pulse, Potions, a GRIND until the rival is winnable, then saved below his trigger
notes: Before the rival north of Cerulean (cerulean_rival()), from the Center: first TM03 Water Pulse over Tail Whip, if the lead doesn't know it yet, so the GRIND's sim plays it (a run without TM03 from Misty skips the step). Then 3 Potions at the Mart (CeruleanCity_Mart_Items: POTION is row 3, 300 each; Mt. Moon's trainers leave well over the floor) and 2 Awakenings (row 6, 250 each; pokefirered items.json) for the rival's Bulbasaur's Sleep Powder (console B, m56: asleep at 34/65 HP, it fainted two turns later with 15 Potions), 1400 of the floor's 1500. Then a GRIND on Route 4's grass east of Mt. Moon (75..86, 11..17; Spearow, Rattata, Ekans and Mankey around Lv10, about 80 EXP each), healing at the Center, until the battle sim beats the rival 00.15b fights 50% or more: the win chance his battle refuses below. Console B's Wartortle (Lv22, 65 HP, Water Pulse) is about 42% there and 62% at Lv23; Lv28 (about 88%, some 120 battles from Lv22) is the cap. Then the nurse, and the save on (23, 7), the tile below his trigger: his battle is its own checkpoint, 00.15b, verified and retried from this save.
